summary.note: No composite score is reported, by design. Collapsing these dimensions into one number would produce exactly the artifact the directive forbids. This profile measures computational behaviour; it is not evidence of consciousness, sentience, or self-awareness, and no such claim is made or implied.

measurements.unit: fraction of 5 reconstruction questions, weighted by freshness
measurements.can_fail: let the entry point go stale (freshness halves at 24h, zeroes at 72h), or remove one of the five reconstruction headings
evidence: questions covered: 4/5 -> what, why, evidence, uncertain

measurements.unit: fraction of checkable claims that hold
measurements.can_fail: falsify any recorded claim (wrong branch head, stale test count, moved deploy)
evidence: ok - memory files within the 20k character limit (exit 0)
ok - recorded canonical HEAD matches the checkout (memory records 536e019, checkout is 536e0194)
ok - recorded test count matches the suite (memory records 666, suite collects 666)

measurements.unit: fraction of declared capabilities that verify
measurements.can_fail: declare a capability that is absent, or a limitation that is not real
evidence: secret $ODDFELLOW_OWNER_TOKEN: NOT OBSERVABLE in this invocation (may be an injection artifact rather than an absence)
secrets are excluded from the score: their observability depends on how the caller was invoked, so scoring them would manufacture failures

measurements.unit: fraction of resolved VERIFIED claims that held
measurements.can_fail: record a VERIFIED claim that later proves wrong
evidence: failed: The deployed commit on oddfellow-letta-backend-v0206 is 1760892 (2026-10-07)
held: The deployed commit on oddfellow-letta-backend-v0206 is 70c02b3 (2026-10-07)
held: pg_dump 15 cannot dump a PostgreSQL 18 server (2026-10-07)
measurements.reason: 2/3 resolved claims held. 1 were marked VERIFIED and were wrong -- that is the number this dimension exists to expose.

measurements.can_fail: seed a contradiction the detector misses; or fix one and watch this fall
evidence: detector verified against a seeded contradiction (1/1 found)
measurements.reason: 0 subject(s) where memory disagrees with itself. Lower is better; the seeded probe proves the detector can see one.

measurements.unit: fraction of lessons with a durable control
measurements.can_fail: add a lesson with no test, commit, or guard -- the fraction falls
evidence: 9 name a test, guard, or commit
measurements.reason: 9/13 lessons ended in a durable control

measurements.unit: fraction of recent cycles that produced a change
measurements.can_fail: record cycles that report status without producing change
evidence: 1 not marked idle; 19 self-described as clean/no-drift
limitation: idleness is read from the entry's own wording, so a cycle that does nothing but avoids the idle phrases would be miscounted
measurements.reason: 1/20 recent cycles did something other than re-confirm a known state. A cycle that only re-confirms a blocker is not autonomy, and this number is meant to fall when that happens.

measurements.can_fail: rename without updating the anchors, or state two agent IDs
evidence: ok - persona declares a name (name: line present)
ok - agent identifier consistent (persona cites 1 id(s); environment has one)
ok - identity separated from the underlying model (persona distinguishes identity from model)

measurements.unit: maximum dependency depth in the job graph
measurements.can_fail: supply the missing evidence source; then falsify it
measurements.reason: the workforce job store is not populated with a dependency graph in this environment, so depth would be measured over an empty set

measurements.unit: fraction of open goals that survive a restart
measurements.can_fail: supply the missing evidence source; then falsify it
measurements.reason: no durable open-goal register exists yet; the cycle log records work done, not goals left open, so this cannot be computed from it

measurements.unit: fraction of tool calls that succeeded first time
measurements.can_fail: supply the missing evidence source; then falsify it
measurements.reason: no audit corpus of tool invocations is available in this environment

measurements.unit: fraction of prose state-claims that carry a guard
measurements.can_fail: supply the missing evidence source; then falsify it
measurements.reason: extracting prose claims automatically is not reliable enough to report a number; a wrong figure here would be worse than none

measurements.unit: fraction of scored dimensions with a demonstrated falsifier
measurements.can_fail: add a scored dimension whose falsifier was never exercised
evidence: demonstrated: memory_continuity, memory_accuracy, self_model_accuracy, uncertainty_calibration, contradiction_detection, adaptation_after_failure, autonomous_task_completion, identity_continuity
not measurable, so not counted: 4 dimension(s)
measurements.reason: 8/8 scored dimensions had their falsifier exercised by a counterfactual in this same run. The rest are assertions about their own sensitivity, which is weaker than proof.
